Based on the provided image of the **buskool.com** product detail page, here is a detailed description of its layout and components, specifically noting the **Right-to-Left (RTL)** orientation:

### 1. Overall Layout (Gallery, Info, Sidebar)
The page follows a standard e-commerce structure adapted for RTL.
*   **Main Container:** The content is centered with a max-width.
*   **Top Section (Product Focus):** This area is split into two main columns:
    *   **Right Column (Product Gallery):** Positioned on the right side, this section features a large, square product image (showing pistachios). It has a clean white background and rounded corners.
    *   **Left Column (Product Information):** Positioned to the left of the image. This column contains the product title ("پسته اکبری ۳۴"), the breadcrumb navigation, the detailed specification list, and the primary Call-to-Action (CTA) button.
*   **Bottom Section:** Below the main product area, there are sections for "Product Description" (توضیحات محصول), "Comments/Reviews" (which appears to be loading or empty in the screenshot), and a "Related Products" (محصولات مرتبط) grid at the very bottom.

### 2. Breadcrumb
Located at the very top of the left information column, above the product title.
*   **Content:** It displays the navigation path: `صفحه اصلی` (Home) > `کشاورزی` (Agriculture) > `خشکبار` (Dried Fruits) > `بادام` (Almond - though the product is pistachios, the breadcrumb says Almond) > `پسته اکبری ۳۴`.
*   **Style:** Small, grey text with forward-slash (`/`) separators. The text is aligned to the right.

### 3. The Product Info List
Situated below the product title in the left column. It uses a grid or list format to display key specifications with icons on the right and values on the left.
*   **Seller Name:** Labeled "نام فروشنده" (Seller Name), followed by the value "صمدی رضا" (Sami Reza).
*   **Address:** Labeled "آدرس" (Address), showing "گچساران - شهر پیل".
*   **Stock/Material:** Labeled "موجودی مواد" (Material Availability), showing "آبی" (Blue/Water).
*   **Weight:** Labeled "حداقل فروش" (Min Sale / Weight), showing "۱ کیلو" (1 Kg).

### 4. 'مشاهده قیمت' (View Price) Button Design
This is the primary interactive element in the top-left info section.
*   **Position:** Located below the info list.
*   **Visuals:**
    *   **Shape:** A wide, rectangular block with rounded corners (pill shape).
    *   **Color:** Light orange/peach background (`#FFE4C4` approx).
    *   **Text:** Orange text that reads "مشاهده قیمت و تماس" (View Price and Contact). There is a small phone icon or similar graphic integrated into the text.
    *   **Style:** It looks distinct from a solid "Buy Now" button, suggesting an inquiry-based or contact-for-price model common in B2B or wholesale sites.

### 5. Chat Widget at Bottom
There is a floating interaction element near the bottom center/left of the viewport (overlaying the content slightly).
*   **Design:** It looks like a chat input bar or a "Quick Contact" card.
*   **Content:** It shows a user avatar, the name "صمدی رضا با واکنش" (Sami Reza with reaction), a price "۰۰۰,۰۰۰ تومان", and action buttons like "تماس با فروشنده" (Contact Seller) in orange and "چت با فروشنده" (Chat with Seller) in orange outline.
*   **Functionality:** It serves as a sticky footer or popup to encourage immediate contact with the seller.

### 6. Right Sidebar Cards
While the main layout is two-column (Image | Info), there are specific informational elements often found in sidebars or inline cards. In this specific view, we see a "Secure Payment / Trust" banner and warning cards:
*   **Secure Payment Banner:** A large, prominent horizontal banner located in the middle-lower section (spanning width). It has an orange gradient background with an illustration of boxes/packages. Text reads "محصول بخرید فوری بفرست؟" (Buy product, send immediately?) and a button "بیشتر بدانید" (Know More).
*   **Warning Card (Police/Fraud):** Visible just above the comments section or near the chat widget. It has a light orange background with a shield icon. The text warns users about fraud: "لطفاً پیش از انجام معامله..." (Please before doing any transaction...). This acts as a safety trust badge.

### 7. Related Products Section
Located at the very bottom of the page.
*   **Title:** "محصولات مرتبط" (Related Products) aligned to the right.
*   **Layout:** A responsive grid of product cards (appears to be 4 or 5 columns wide).
*   **Card Design:** Each card is a placeholder (skeleton loader style) in this screenshot—light grey rectangles representing images and lines representing text. This indicates the section is either loading or is a structural mockup for where related items will appear.
